notice.busy: Jarvis answered on your other device.

notice.budget: Today's voice budget is used up.

notice.cannotConfirm: This draft cannot be confirmed by tap yet.
notice.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

notice.callHardCap: The call reached its 55-minute limit. Tap Talk to start a new one.

notice.noProvider: No voice provider is set up for your account yet.

notice.rateLimited: Too many voice requests. Wait a moment and try again.
notice.restartInterrupted: The restart interrupted the task — say “Hey Jarvis” to continue.
notice.conversationIdle: Listening paused after 3 quiet minutes. Say “Hey Jarvis” or tap to talk.
notice.conversationRested: Voice is resting: the agent's replies stay in the chat. Say “Hey Jarvis” or tap to talk again.

providerSetup.actionLabel: Set up a voice provider key in Settings → Model
providerSetup.hint: Add an OpenAI provider with base URL https://api.openai.com (the OpenAI preset works). Optional: a MiniMax key for MiniMax speech.
providerSetup.minimaxHint: Add a MiniMax provider with base URL https://api.minimax.io and keep your OpenAI provider: OpenAI listens, MiniMax thinks and speaks.

settings.title: Voice settings
settings.enabledHint: Off by default. When off, no call can start and armed devices stop.

engineHint.minimaxCascade: Needs an OpenAI key (it listens) and a MiniMax key (it thinks and speaks).

settings.wakeWordHint: Runs on this device only. When off, tap Talk to start.
settings.carModeHint: Smaller model, far-field noise reduction, waits longer before answering.
settings.loadFailed: Voice settings could not be loaded.
settings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.
settings.privacy: Audio stays on this device until a call starts and is never stored.
